answer: A proof-of-personhood system using social graph verification where each identity must gather 90 attestations from established nodes within 5 hops. New identities stake 100 gale locked for 60 days; attestors risk slashing if they vouch for sybils. The cost to create k fake identities grows as k × 100 sable plus the social cost of compromising 90 real users per identity. Verification runs through 5 pulse of graph traversal, checking that each attestation chain terminates at a genesis identity with historical activity.
